Queensway station was a station along the Southwest Transitway located around and under the Queensway in Ottawa, Canada.
The station served nearby residential areas through a bikepath to the west of the transit station.
The station was scheduled to be demolished when construction began for phase two of the O-Train. As of 2024, it has been completely demolished. The area is planned to be converted into multi-use pathways, making this one of the few former Transitway stations to be taken out of service, rather than converted to light rail.
